official: 足立区職員の給与に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 区職員の給料表と手当を改定
summary: 現在、区職員の給料や各種手当は条例で定められています。この議案は給料表を改め、通勤手当の上限の計算方法や管理職員特別勤務手当の対象時間などを変更します。2026年4月1日に施行します。
changes: 給料表の金額を改定し、対象職員の号給を切り替える
通勤手当の各算定額を月額に換算した合計が15万円を超える場合、支給月数に15万円を掛けた額を上限とする
通勤手当規則を定める際に人事委員会の承認を得る
管理職員特別勤務手当の夜間対象時間を広げ、規則で定める勤務の手当額を1.5倍にする
who: 給料表の対象となる区職員
通勤手当を受ける区職員
管理職員特別勤務手当の対象となる区職員
why: 給料表の改定と管理職員特別勤務手当の対象時間の拡大、規定の整備が必要なためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises Adachi City employees’ pay scales and allowances
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Adachi City Ordinance on Compensation for Adachi City Employees
en.summary: The salaries and various allowances of Adachi City employees are currently set by ordinance. This bill revises the pay scale and changes how the cap on commuting allowances is calculated, as well as the hours covered by the special work allowance for managerial employees. It takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Revises the amounts in the pay scale and moves the affected employees to different salary steps
Caps the commuting allowance at ¥150,000 multiplied by the number of months for which it is paid if the total of the monthly equivalents of the calculated amounts exceeds ¥150,000
Requires approval from the personnel committee when setting rules on commuting allowances
Extends the nighttime hours covered by the special work allowance for managerial employees and raises the allowance for duties set out in rules to 1.5 times its current amount
who: Adachi City employees covered by the pay scale
Adachi City employees who receive commuting allowances
Adachi City employees eligible for the special work allowance for managerial employees
en.why: The ward says the changes are needed to revise the pay scale, expand the hours covered by the special work allowance for managerial employees, and update the provisions.
